dirty_change.intent_in_working_tree_comment: Target approximately 1.8 N per centered flat pad and roughly 2x the static vertical-load requirement at mu=1.5.
dirty_change.rationale: The 0.9 mm tuning was uncommitted and lacked a corresponding formal artifact. Restoring 0.3 mm removes source ambiguity without adopting an unvalidated main-repository design change. Stage 2B rollout code remains isolated under spike/.

round5_provenance.conclusion: All 21 Round-5 official, baseline, settle, smoke, and Pareto artifacts used 0.3 mm. The sole 1.5 mm result is explicitly named and documented as a diagnostic preload probe. No Round-5 artifact used 0.9 mm.
